import json,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from tests.test_research_conditional import conditional_producer
from tests.test_research_adaptive_report import encoded,mutate,sha,validate
from quant_company.research.adaptive_executor import qualification_from_file,ExecutionBlocked
from quant_company.research.adaptive_report import ValidationError
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='conditional-review-qualification-final-') as directory:
    fixture=conditional_producer(Path(directory))
    path,assignment,manifest,profile,contents=fixture
    validate(fixture)
    baseline_accepted=True
    sealed_date=manifest.spec.sealed[0].start.isoformat()
    replacements={'json_dates':[sealed_date],'json_datetimes':[sealed_date+'T18:00:00+09:00'],'sample_count':1}
    contents['producer-qualification.json']=encoded(json.loads(contents['producer-qualification.json'])|replacements)
    mutate(fixture,'qualification.json',lambda payload:payload.update(**replacements,producer_sha256=sha(contents['producer-qualification.json'])))
    source=Path(directory)/'check-producer-qualification.json'
    source.write_bytes(contents['producer-qualification.json'])
    try:
        qualification_from_file(source,manifest,profile,producer=True)
    except ExecutionBlocked as exc:worker={'accepted':False,'reason':str(exc)}
    else:worker={'accepted':True}
    try:
        validate(fixture)
    except ValidationError as exc:consumer={'accepted':False,'reason':str(exc)}
    else:consumer={'accepted':True}
    assert not worker['accepted'] and not consumer['accepted']
    print(json.dumps({'baseline_accepted':baseline_accepted,'worker':worker,'consumer':consumer,'market_price_rows_read':False,'scientific_trials_added':0}))
